description: Get a ready-to-paste client configuration for one MCP server: an mcpServers entry for your MCP client config, plus a docs link to the full 6-tool reference (https://mcpyp.com/#/find, For machines tab). If the server requires a publisher API key, the config contains a <YOUR_API_KEY> placeholder plus where to obtain the key; MCPYP never issues, stores, or brokers keys. Pass the same journey_id as the pick step so the funnel conversion is logged.

journey_id.description: Same journey_id as the pick step

name.description: Server name or slug from find_mcp results

name: get_config
